home.intro: We build practical data tools, focused automations, and lightweight web apps that help small teams do better work.
home.buildIntro: Start with one bottleneck. Every engagement should produce something your team can use—not a transformation slide deck.
home.service1Text: Bring scattered data together in reliable reporting, dashboards, and decision-ready views your team can actually use.
home.service2Text: Hand repetitive work to focused workflows and assistants that connect your tools while keeping people in control.
home.service3Text: Give your team or customers a focused portal, interface, landing page, or custom tool built around one clear job.
home.approachTitle: A small first version, built around reality.
home.approachIntro: Four checkpoints keep the work understandable, useful, and maintainable.
home.step1Text: We look at how the task works today and identify what is genuinely slowing the team down.
home.step2Text: We define one useful outcome, the boundaries, and what should deliberately wait.
home.step3Text: A working version arrives early and improves through short feedback cycles.
home.step4Text: The result is documented and designed so it does not become another fragile dependency.
home.workIntro: Concrete, bounded projects that can prove their value before anything grows.
home.project1Text: Bring key numbers from spreadsheets or exports into one dependable view.
home.project2Text: Extract, classify, or route recurring documents with a human still in control.
home.project3Text: Replace a manual tracker or awkward process with a small purpose-built interface.
home.closingTitle: What could work better in your business?
home.footerText: Practical data, automation, and software for small teams.

dataAnalytics.title: Turn scattered data into clear direction.
dataAnalytics.intro: We organize the numbers your business already produces into dependable reporting, dashboards, and data systems that make decisions easier.
dataAnalytics.outcomesTitle: From looking for numbers to using them.
dataAnalytics.outcomesIntro: The goal is not another dashboard. It is a shared view of the business that people trust and know how to use.
dataAnalytics.outcome1Text: Bring important numbers from spreadsheets, exports, and business tools into one consistent reporting system.
dataAnalytics.outcome2Text: Replace recurring copy-and-paste preparation with repeatable data flows and reports that update predictably.
dataAnalytics.outcome3Text: Give managers and teams the right level of detail without asking an analyst to rebuild every answer.
dataAnalytics.capabilitiesTitle: The useful layer between raw data and decisions.
dataAnalytics.capabilitiesIntro: We can start with a single report or design the foundations underneath it. The scope follows the business problem, not a fixed technology package.
dataAnalytics.capability1Text: Clear operational and executive views centered on the questions your team asks every week.
dataAnalytics.capability1Detail: Power BI · Custom dashboards · KPI design
dataAnalytics.capability2Text: Clean models and dependable pipelines that turn fragmented sources into consistent business definitions.
dataAnalytics.capability2Detail: SQL modeling · Data pipelines · Source integration
dataAnalytics.capability3Text: Focused investigation of performance, patterns, and opportunities with conclusions people can act on.
dataAnalytics.storyTitle: What a reporting transformation can look like.
dataAnalytics.storyIntro: A simplified example of the change we often help teams make, without presenting invented client results.
dataAnalytics.afterTitle: A view the team can use
afterItems: Clear path from metric to source
dataAnalytics.processTitle: Start with one decision that needs better data.
dataAnalytics.processIntro: A focused first version lets us prove the definitions, sources, and workflow before the system grows.
dataAnalytics.step1Text: We map where the numbers come from, how they are prepared today, and which definitions create disagreement.
dataAnalytics.step2Text: We clean and structure the minimum data needed for one useful report or analytical view.
dataAnalytics.step3Text: The first version is tested with the people using it, documented, and handed over with a clear path to expand.
dataAnalytics.closingEyebrow: Start with the numbers you already have.
dataAnalytics.closingTitle: Which decision takes too long because the data is unclear?

digitalWorkers.title: Hand repetitive work to focused digital workers.

digitalWorkers.benefitsTitle: Specific automation for a specific job.

digitalWorkers.benefit1: Routine work moves without copy and paste
digitalWorkers.benefit2: Human approval stays where judgment matters
digitalWorkers.benefit3: Existing tools connect through clear workflows

digitalWorkers.step3Text: Connect the tools and test real operating cases.

webApps.benefitsTitle: A useful product without unnecessary weight.

webApps.benefit1: Clear flows built around a real task

webApps.step4Text: Test, measure, document, and put it into use.
